Build

Quickstart (mise)

mise pins the exact Go and Node toolchains and installs them if missing:

mise run build     # npm run build in ui/, then go build -o guardbee .
mise run check     # build + go vet + go test
mise run clean     # rm -f guardbee
mise run ui-dev    # frontend dev server, hot reload (proxies /api to
                    # a separately-running "guardbee ui" on :4747)

mise run build always rebuilds the frontend first — the Go binary embeds whatever is currently in ui/dist via go:embed (see embed.go), so a stale ui/dist would silently ship an outdated UI otherwise.

Plain Go

Build the frontend yourself once — go:embed requires ui/dist to exist — then a plain go build works:

cd ui && npm install && npm run build
cd .. && go build -o guardbee .

Built against github.com/cilium/cilium@v1.20.2 as a plain Go dependency — including the internal pkg/policy engine, not just the generated clientset and Hubble’s observer gRPC stubs. No eBPF/CGO/ privileged build step required.

Shell completions

Generated from globals.go’s binName by scripts/gen-completions.sh (mise run completions to regenerate after a rename or a flag/subcommand change):

# bash, in ~/.bashrc
source completions/guardbee.bash

# fish: or copy to ~/.config/fish/completions/
source completions/guardbee.fish

# zsh: anywhere on your $fpath, then `compinit`
cp completions/_guardbee ~/.zsh/completions/
